artifacts_scope_check.name: artifacts_scope_check
artifacts_scope_check.value:
(
        ("artifacts"."worksheet_id" IS NULL AND "artifacts"."work_id" IS NULL AND "artifacts"."task_id" IS NULL AND "artifacts"."stage_column_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("artifacts"."worksheet_id" IS NOT NULL AND "artifacts"."work_id" IS NOT NULL AND "artifacts"."task_id" IS NULL AND "artifacts"."stage_column_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("artifacts"."worksheet_id" IS NOT NULL AND "artifacts"."work_id" IS NULL AND "artifacts"."task_id" IS NOT NULL AND "artifacts"."stage_column_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("artifacts"."worksheet_id" IS NOT NULL AND "artifacts"."work_id" IS NULL AND "artifacts"."task_id" IS NOT NULL AND "artifacts"."stage_column_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

change_logs_project_docs_created_idx.name: change_logs_project_docs_created_idx

resource_locations_type_check.name: resource_locations_type_check
resource_locations_type_check.value:
(
        ("resource_locations"."type" = 'cloud_link' AND "resource_locations"."provider" IS NOT NULL AND "resource_locations"."url" IS NOT NULL AND "resource_locations"."blob_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("resource_locations"."type" = 'r2' AND "resource_locations"."blob_id" IS NOT NULL AND "resource_locations"."url" IS NULL AND "resource_locations"."extract_code" IS NULL)
      )
